items.summary: OpenPanel js-runtime (through commit bad75bdd) has a sandbox escape in its JavaScript webhook template validator: computed member access reaches the Function constructor, letting an attacker with project write access execute arbitrary code in the shared worker process.

IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 vulnerability batch (disclosed 19 Sep 2026) — CVE-2026-84064 is the highest-scoring of four 9.9 CVEs covering unauthenticated RCE, SQL injection and authentication bypass with no confirmed exploitation yet.
Synology-SA-26:13 (18 Sep 2026): improper encoding/escaping in SCGI in DiskStation Manager lets remote attackers read or write arbitrary files and trigger denial of service on unpatched NAS devices.

Gravity Forms for WordPress (through 3.1.0.4) suffers an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload: a validation bypass lets hidden upload fields skip extension checks, enabling remote code execution via public forms.

Check Point Security Management / Log Server stack overflow in the pre-auth login process lets an unauthenticated remote attacker execute code as root; patched via LivePatch advisory sk1000155 (record active 17–18 Sep 2026).
